buildCommand: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env }; if (!env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is required for svc-api build'); if (!env.DIRECT_URL) env.DIRECT_URL = env.DATABASE_URL.replace('-pooler.', '.'); execSync('pnpm -F @workspace/db db:push && pnpm --filter svc-api exec nest build', { stdio: 'inherit', env });"
